verification.command: native_rust_exact_build_offline.verify_inputs over the live clean d0947e0c checkout, assets and manifest with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1

original_failures: The first no-checkout worktree had its index intentionally empty until a non-destructive mixed reset populated it; its initial status was rejected.
The host lacked rpm2cpio, so the first debrand extraction command failed before output; the retained cached debrand asset was used and will be compared with the pinned SRPM inside the prepared image.
The first full-manifest generator treated unrelated gitlinks as regular files and failed on a directory; the bounded driver correction now binds exact gitlink object IDs.

The clean c140d23f input snapshot was superseded after the signal-evidence source correction; its compressed manifest is retained, and a fresh clean d0947e0c checkout and manifest were independently regenerated.
limitations: Input identity is not image preparation, configured build, runtime or acceptance evidence.
